distinctness.verdict: DISTINCT — survives BOTH adjacent-lane controls (habituation, homeostatic-drive) + ablation + shuffle. NOT a depletion signal.
distinctness.vs_H_1465_habituation: habituation = a falling, stimulus-specific RESPONSE trace driven by REPETITION COUNT only, reward-BLIND. On a repeated-but-still-rewarding stimulus a habituation-style readout disengages (response decayed, 0.900) but boredom STAYS ENGAGED (0.000) because the reward channel is still high and the AND-conjunction is unmet. The reward conjunction is exactly what habituation lacks. DISTINCT (gap 0.900).
distinctness.vs_H_1292_homeostatic_drive: homeostatic drive = a leaky TIME-INTEGRAL of a setpoint deficit, STIMULUS-AGNOSTIC (rises with elapsed ticks regardless of stimulus content). On a satiated-but-monotonous stimulus boredom disengages (1.000, informational/semantic depletion) while a drive-style readout does not (0.000, bodily deficit satiated); conversely on a novel+rewarding+deprived stimulus boredom stays engaged (0.000) while drive rises (0.875). The two track DIFFERENT variables. DISTINCT (gap 1.000).
distinctness.vs_H_1289_novelty: novelty = one-shot NEW-stimulus detection (the info channel's first derivative), no reward term, not a disengage decision. Folded into the info channel + the reward conjunction: novelty/info depletion ALONE does not disengage boredom (c2-hab's reward-high block keeps boredom engaged). DISTINCT by the reward conjunction.
distinctness.conclusion: boredom's lift is the META-MOTIVATIONAL CONJUNCTION (disengage iff reward-depleted AND info-depleted) — habituation (reward-blind decay) and homeostatic-drive (stimulus-agnostic integral) each lack one half of the conjunction and both fail to reproduce the targeted disengagement; ablating the conjunction (AND->OR) collapses boredom onto the single-channel lanes (c3) and shuffling the reward/info alignment collapses it to chance (c4).
